tests.scope: V19+V20+V22 geometry/color, identity evidence and OCR mocks, automatic ROI/anchor guards, Korean paired assets, copy counts, data integrity/audit/export, one-start Tk workflow, split workers, mocked HTTP; no physical camera or live server

fault_injection_limit: SystemExit after durable file writes, not physical power cuts or cloud sync
config_check_stdout: V22 config/layouts/camera settings OK: A=12 B=16 C=12 D=64. Hardware/models not opened.
migration: Existing V21 v1 bundles require selected-scene rebuild before V22 automatic export; originals retained; no bulk migration.
limitations: Software test paths passed; current physical A/B accuracy is unmeasured and no perfect-results claim is made.
Automatic registration requires readable upright bay names and closed convex quadrilateral boundaries.
No trained occupancy or vehicle-mask violation model is bundled. Without model/reference, absent sticker means unknown.
Automatic candidates and human-approved truth remain distinct; information completeness is not accuracy.
V21 real CPU OCR synthetic results are historical evidence, not rerun V22 performance measurements.
RealSense, current physical data, GPU, trained models, live server, Geti, long duration, actual power cuts and sync conflicts are untested.
UI was inspected on current PC only; not every DPI/window size, nor final compact advanced layout.
No multi-process dataset write lock, bulk migration or automatic duplicate-image filtering.
Rebuild refuses corrupt originals, missing promised predictions or invalid reviews; it cannot recover absent truth.
One program may write a dataset at a time. Do not edit V22 bundles with V21.
Exports copy and preserve originals; result receipt JSON is separate from data JSON count.
